title: ResponseTooLarge
description:
⟨rev7⟩ The typed detail of a `USAGE_ERROR` / `response_too_large` refusal (ADR-0013 §4,
D19). **Partly attached:** a snapshot over a cap (PC1, §5.5) sets [`ErrorDetail`]'s
`section` and `narrow`; `ErrorDetail` gains `limit_bytes` in the change that emits it (U3,
PC4), with the CLI and the wrapper.

limit_bytes.description: The frame or budget limit the answer would exceed, in bytes.

resource.description:
A legacy over-limit item met by a page or a point `inspect`, by ID, with its
remediation through the existing catalog command.

section.description: The section that is over its cap (a snapshot's `operations`, `pending_decisions`).

ResourceRef.description: A reference to the resource an error concerns. Opaque IDs only; never a secret.
